members.name: Pipwort Bramblecap
members.role: Eldest of the hollow; keeps its memory and its gardens' calendar
ties: her mother and Hollbrenna were friends

members.name: Sorrel Underbank
members.role: Pipwort's cousin and the hollow's seed-keeper; tends the oldest garden plots
ties: trades seeds with Gaudra of Highshelf
teaches the hollow's children the planting songs
worries the old forest is being cut too close

members.name: Mallow Bramblecap
members.role: Pipwort's daughter; keeps the common table and the hollow's ovens
ties: feeds the hollow at the common table
trades honey with the Ferncross woodcutters

members.name: Betony Mossfoot
members.role: Mallow's wife; makes salves from the old forest's plants and tends the hollow's sick
ties: trades salves with the Tanglewood healer
tends the hollow's children through fevers

members.name: Thistle Mossfoot
members.role: pedlar on the east road: carries fibre to Reedmoor's market and brings fish back
ties: friendly with the Coombes of the Lakemead

members.name: Clover Mossfoot
members.role: Thistle's wife; tends the hollow's fibre patch and the flax that fills his packs
ties: trades flax with the Reedmoor reed-cutters
argues with Sorrel Underbank about the seed rows
wants a larger garden of her own

members.name: Tansy Mossfoot
members.role: Thistle and Clover's daughter; runs the garden paths and knows every flower by name
ties: follows her grandmother Betony about the salve shed

members.name: Yarrow Underbank
members.role: works only fallen wood; builds the hollow's frames, shelves and garden gates
ties: trades tools with the Ferncross woodcutters
refuses to fell a living tree
friendly with the giant Eirik when he comes down

members.name: Marjoram Underbank
members.role: Yarrow's wife; bakes the hollow's bread and keeps the herb garden by the oven
ties: trades bread with the Reedmoor market

members.name: Fennel Underbank
members.role: Yarrow and Marjoram's son; helps in the garden and follows his father about the woodpile
ties: wants to learn the pedlar's road from Thistle Mossfoot

members.name: Sorrel Fenwick
members.role: fishes the forest streams and smokes the catch for the hollow's table
ties: trades smoked fish with Thistle Mossfoot's packs
knows the stream pools better than anyone
grudges the Kettlebridge works for the smoke that drifts east

members.name: Reed Fenwick
members.role: Sorrel's son; fishes the streams with her and learns the weirs
ties: wants to see the sea at Lanternquay

members.name: Rush Fenwick
members.role: Sorrel's daughter; mends nets and keeps the smoke shed tidy

members.name: Hazel Bramblecap
members.role: Pipwort's niece; keeps the hollow's salve store and walks to Tanglewood for herbs
ties: trades herbs with the Tanglewood healer

members.name: Sorrel Bramblecap
members.role: Hazel's husband; works the hollow's grain patch and the berry rows
ties: trades berries with the Ferncross woodcutters
grumbles at the giants' track for the timber it takes
wants a second strip by the stream

members.name: Tamarisk Bramblecap
members.role: Hazel and Sorrel's daughter; gathers berries and follows her mother to the salve shed
ties: afraid of the deep caves in the hills

members.name: Bramble Quill
members.role: keeps the hollow's garden rolls and writes the Eldest's letters
ties: corresponds with Ostrander Sallow of Lanternquay
trades letters for fish with the Reedmoor market

members.name: Vetch Quill
members.role: Bramble's wife; keeps the hollow's root garden and the beehives
ties: trades honey with the Ferncross woodcutters
argues with Clover Mossfoot about the seed rows

members.name: Sorrel Quill
members.role: Bramble and Vetch's daughter; learns her letters and helps with the hives

members.name: Alder Rush
members.role: buys the hollow's fibre and salves and sells them on the east road; keeps the hollow's store of marks
ties: trades with Nell Sedge at Reedmoor
owes Thistle Mossfoot a share of a load
wants the hollow to trade more with the giants

members.name: Willow Rush
members.role: Alder's wife; tends the hollow's flax and the garden by the stream
ties: trades flax with the Reedmoor reed-cutters
worries the old forest is being cut too close

members.name: Bracken Rush
members.role: Alder and Willow's son; helps in the store and counts the packs
ties: wants to walk the east road with Thistle Mossfoot

members.name: Bracken Sedge
members.role: builds the hollow's frames and gates from fallen wood; keeps the hollow's tools
ties: refuses to fell a living tree

members.name: Tansy Sedge
members.role: Bracken's wife; keeps the hollow's kitchen and feeds the elders at the root table
ties: cooks for the hollow's common table
trades bread with the Reedmoor market

members.name: Sorrel Sedge
members.role: Bracken and Tansy's daughter; follows her mother about the kitchen and the garden
ties: afraid of the wolves that come down the track

members.name: Osier Willow
members.role: fishes the forest streams and keeps the hollow's weirs and traps
ties: trades smoked fish with Alder Rush
grudges the Kettlebridge works for the smoke that drifts east

members.name: Rush Willow
members.role: Osier's wife; tends the hollow's berry rows and the garden by the stream
ties: trades berries with the Ferncross woodcutters
worries the old forest is being cut too close

members.name: Reed Willow
members.role: Osier and Rush's son; helps with the weirs and learns the streams
ties: wants to see the sea at Lanternquay

members.name: Tansy Hazel
members.role: keeps the hollow's market stall and trades fibre and salves with the east road
ties: trades with Nell Sedge at Reedmoor
keeps the hollow's stall at the east road crossing
owes Alder Rush for a load of fibre
friendly with the Coombes of the Lakemead

members.name: Clover Hazel
members.role: Tansy's wife; builds the hollow's shelves and crates from fallen wood
ties: refuses to fell a living tree

members.name: Sorrel Hazel
members.role: Tansy and Clover's daughter; plays in the garden and the market stall
ties: afraid of the deep caves in the hills

situations.summary: A pack of fibre bound for Reedmoor was found opened and half empty at the east road crossing; Thistle Mossfoot blames a Ferncross woodcutter he quarrelled with, and the hollow's traders are divided over whether to keep using the crossing.

sides.Thistle Mossfoot: Lost half a load and is sure the Ferncross man did it; wants the hollow to back him and stop trading at the crossing.
sides.Alder Rush: Thinks Thistle is too quick to blame and does not want the east road trade to fail; wants the loss made good from the common store.
sides.Tansy Hazel: Keeps the stall at the crossing and says the woodcutter was there that night, but she did not see him open the pack.
sides.Bracken Sedge: Mends the packs and says the ties were cut, not broken; thinks it was someone who knew the load, and has said so to Thistle.

situations.summary: The giant Eirik has asked the hollow for fallen timber for the shelf's roofs, and some of the hollow say the old forest's fallen wood should stay for the hollow's own use; Pipwort must decide what the Old Green allows.

sides.Pipwort Bramblecap: Remembers her mother's friendship with Hollbrenna and wants to help the shelf, but will not let the hollow's own wood run short.
sides.Yarrow Underbank: Says fallen wood is the hollow's and the giants have stone enough; will not give up a beam he has been saving.
sides.Alder Rush: Wants to trade the timber for the shelf's meat and hides and thinks the hollow is being small-minded.
sides.Osier Willow: Worries that hauling timber up the track will foul the streams and the weirs, and says so plainly.

situations.summary: Hazel Bramblecap owes the Tanglewood healer for a winter's worth of herbs and has not paid; the healer has sent word that she will not send more until the debt is settled, and the hollow's salve store is running low.

sides.Hazel Bramblecap: Owes the Tanglewood healer and is ashamed; has been paying in salves but not enough, and fears the hollow will go without medicine.
sides.Betony Mossfoot: Knows the debt and has offered to share her own herbs, but thinks Hazel should tell the Eldest before the store runs out.
sides.Pipwort Bramblecap: Has heard the store is low and suspects a debt; wants it settled openly, and would send marks from the common store if the hollow agrees.

situations.summary: Osier Willow and Sorrel Fenwick both fish the same forest streams and each says the other's weirs take the best pools; the hollow's fishers have not settled who may set traps where.

sides.Osier Willow: Says his family has fished the upper pools for generations and Sorrel's weirs block the run.
sides.Sorrel Fenwick: Says Osier's traps take the breeding fish and her smoke shed feeds the hollow; she will not move her weirs.
sides.Reed Fenwick: Fishes beside his mother and has seen Osier's traps in the upper pool; wants the Eldest to set a boundary.
sides.Reed Willow: Helps his father and thinks the Fenwicks have spread too far down the stream; has said so to Reed Fenwick.

situations.summary: Thistle Mossfoot's wife Clover and the trader Tansy Hazel have grown close over the fibre trade, and the hollow is beginning to talk; Clover has not said anything to Thistle, who is often away on the road.

sides.Clover Mossfoot: Knows she is drawn to Tansy and feels guilty; has not told Thistle and does not know what she wants.
sides.Tansy Hazel: Knows Clover's marriage is strained and is unsure whether to step back; has told no one, not even her wife.

situations.summary: Pipwort Bramblecap is old and has not named who will keep the hollow's memory after her; Mallow Bramblecap assumes it will be her as Pipwort's daughter, but Sorrel Underbank has kept the seed store and the calendar beside Pipwort for years.

sides.Pipwort Bramblecap: Has not decided and will not be hurried; wants the hollow to speak before she names anyone.
sides.Mallow Bramblecap: Assumes the memory will pass to her and has begun sitting in at the root table; resents Sorrel's closeness to her mother.
sides.Sorrel Underbank: Has kept the calendar and the seed store and thinks the memory should go to whoever keeps the gardens, not to a daughter by right.
sides.Hazel Bramblecap: Wants the hollow to choose openly and fears a quarrel will split the root table; has urged her aunt to name someone.

situations.summary: The smoke from Kettlebridge's works has drifted east over the hollow's gardens for a week, and the hollow's growers say the leaves are spotting; some want to send word to the Works Council, others say it will blow over and the hollow should not provoke the town.

sides.Sorrel Underbank: Says the seed rows are spotting and the hollow cannot lose a harvest; wants a letter sent to Kettlebridge's Council.
sides.Vetch Quill: Sees the spots on the leaves but thinks a complaint will only make the works burn more; wants to wait for rain.
sides.Sorrel Fenwick: Blames the works for the smoke and the dead fish in the stream and would send word at once.
sides.Alder Rush: Trades with the east road and does not want a quarrel with Kettlebridge; says the hollow has survived worse smoke.
